ariel.truth: observed (greyscale); colour = disc-integrated tint (labelled); unobserved region reconstructed (labelled)
ariel.content: clear-filter greyscale Voyager 2 mosaic × catalogue disc-integrated tint; northern hemisphere unobserved (black, ≈61–62 %) → labelled procedural reconstruction at runtime
ariel.source: USGS Voyager 2 mosaics distributed by NASA/JPL Solar System Simulator (ura1vuu2/ura3vuu2/ura4vuu2.tif, 1440×720), processed by SOL v3.8.1 tools/ingest/uranian_jpl.py

ariel_recon.content: guide field for the labelled reconstruction; contains no imagery beyond 6° Gaussian-smoothed regional albedo
ariel_recon.source: SOL-derived (tools/ingest/partial_recon.py) from the body's own colour map: R = reconstruction weight (0 on observed pixels), G = low-frequency observed albedo carried into the unobserved region
